verdict.rationale: Docs show broad CLI/API coverage of core operations—branch/database CRUD, deploy requests, backups, service tokens, org SSO, insights queries, SQL shell (docs-3,6,7,8,17,41,49)—but explicit gaps remain: the import tool is documented only as a 'dashboard' feature (docs-13/21) and instance/storage graphs 'live on their own tabs' in the UI (docs-2), with no discoverable OpenAPI spec (probe-3) confirming full parity. Missing for 10: documented API/CLI equivalents for the import tool and dashboard analytics graphs, and a publicly discoverable OpenAPI/API reference confirming full UI-API parity.
